Definition: neuter of a compound of G1722 and a derivative of G3700; in the face of (literally or figuratively):--before, in the presence (sight) of, to.
BiblicalUsage: Enopion is 'in the face of' — before, in the sight of. No flesh should glory in His presence in 1 Corinthians 1:29, a meek and quiet spirit is in the sight of God of great price in 1 Peter 3:4, and what we ask we receive because we do what is pleasing in His sight in 1 John 3:22.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe everything is done in God's sight, and that sight is not a threat but a comfort — the meek spirit is of great price to Him, and no flesh can boast there. I hold that living in His sight is the freest way to live, because there is nothing to hide and nothing to prove.
RelatedPeople: Paul; Simon Peter; John the Apostle
